untertitel: Backups copy your folders one way to another drive, NAS or the cloud. Mirrors keep two folders the same. Deleted items stay in the target's recycle bin for 30 days.
leer: No mirror job yet. Create one above, for example from the backup folder to an external drive.
ausstehend_text: Drive was missing – will catch up as soon as it is connected
waechter_aus: currently off ({grund}) – restarts in one minute
vorschau_laeuft: Calculating what would change – nothing is modified.
vorschau_nichts: Everything is already in sync – nothing would change.
vorschau_papierkorb: Anything deleted or overwritten at the destination first goes to the destination share's recycle bin for 30 days.
loeschen_frage: Delete mirror job “{name}”? The folders and their contents stay untouched.
name: Name
name_erklaerung: So you can recognize the mirror job in the list and on the dashboard.
quelle_erklaerung: Syncs from here. With “two-way”, source and destination are equal.
ziel_erklaerung: Syncs to here, including external drives. If the folder is missing, it is created on the first run.
unterordner_erklaerung: Empty = the entire share. Type a path or pick one with “Choose folder”.
richtung_einseitig_erklaerung: The destination becomes an exact copy of the source; changes at the destination are overwritten. Right for backup copies.
richtung_beidseitig_erklaerung: Changes travel in both directions. In a conflict the newer version wins; the other is kept as a copy next to it.
ausloeser_zeitplan_erklaerung: Runs on the selected days at the given times. If the NAS was off, the last run is caught up.
ausloeser_aenderung_erklaerung: Runs as soon as something changes in the folders and things then stay quiet for the wait time.
ausloeser_hand_erklaerung: Only runs when you click “Sync now”.
tage_erklaerung: The mirror job runs on these days.
zeiten_erklaerung: One or more times, separated by commas, e.g. 05:00, 17:30.
wartezeit_erklaerung: How long things must stay quiet after the last change. Many changes in a row thus result in a single run.
aktiv_erklaerung: Off = paused: only runs manually, the settings are kept.
papierkorb_hinweis: Anything deleted or overwritten at the destination first goes to the destination share's recycle bin for 30 days.
ort_erklaerung: “This NAS” or another NAS from “Other NAS and cloud storage” below.
fern_erklaerung: Connections to other NAS (SMB) and cloud storage (S3, Backblaze B2, WebDAV/Nextcloud, SFTP). They can then be chosen as source or destination in any mirror job.
fern_leer: No connection to another NAS yet.
fern_loeschen_frage: Delete connection “{name}”? Nothing changes on the other NAS.
fern_loeschen_gesperrt: Still used by a mirror job – change that first.
fern_name_erklaerung: Short name under which the NAS appears in mirror jobs.
fern_adresse_erklaerung: IP address or host name of the other NAS, e.g. 192.168.1.23.
fern_benutzer_erklaerung: Account on the other NAS that may read and write the shares.
fern_passwort_erklaerung: Stays locked away on this NAS and is never shown again.
fern_dialog_hinweis: With another NAS, changes there are only noticed on the next run – a schedule works best. If the NAS is off, the run is caught up.
fern_art_smb_erklaerung: Shares of another NAS on the home network (UGREEN, Synology, Windows PC …).
fern_art_s3_erklaerung: Object storage such as Amazon S3, Hetzner, Wasabi, IONOS or MinIO. Cloud mirror jobs run one-way (backup to the cloud or fetch from the cloud).
fern_art_b2_erklaerung: Backblaze B2 – affordable cloud storage for backups. Create the key under “Application Keys”.
fern_art_webdav_erklaerung: Nextcloud, ownCloud or any WebDAV storage. For Nextcloud, use an app password.
fern_art_sftp_erklaerung: A server with SSH access, e.g. a Storage Box or another Linux system.
fern_endpunkt_erklaerung: S3: leave empty for Amazon, otherwise the provider's endpoint address. WebDAV: full address of the folder.
fern_region_erklaerung: Only if the provider requires one, e.g. eu-central-1.
fern_schluessel_id_erklaerung: For S3 the “Access Key ID”, for Backblaze the “keyID”.
sa_quelle_erklaerung: Choose the share to back up. The backup copies it regularly to a second place.
sa_unterordner_info: Leave empty for the whole share.
sa_ziel_erklaerung: A backup belongs on another device – if a disk fails, the copy is still there.
sa_ziel_laufwerk_info: A mounted external disk or a storage pool on this NAS.
sa_ziel_nas_info: A share on another NAS on the network (SMB).
sa_ziel_cloud_info: S3, Backblaze B2, WebDAV/Nextcloud or SFTP.
sa_keine_laufwerke: No external drive mounted. Plug in a USB disk and mount it under Drives.
sa_laufwerk_info: The backup goes into the folder FAH-NAS/<share> there.
sa_keine_nas: No connection to another NAS yet.
sa_verbindung_info: Saved connection (credentials stay on this NAS).
sa_fern_freigabe_info: The backup goes into the folder FAH-NAS/<share> there.
sa_wann_erklaerung: Best at night, when nobody changes files.
sa_taeglich_info: Every day at the chosen time – recommended.
sa_woechentlich_info: Once a week, e.g. for a disk that is rarely plugged in.
sa_aenderung_info: Shortly after every change – always up to date, but uses disks and network more often.
sa_tag_info: The backup runs on this day.
sa_einseitig_info: The backup is a one-way mirror: overwritten or deleted files stay at the destination as “older versions” and can be restored.
sa_plan_da: This share already has a snapshot schedule – it stays as it is.
sa_schnappschuesse_info: One daily (kept 14 days) and one weekly (8 weeks) – so older versions can be restored too.
sa_sofort_info: Starts the first run immediately instead of waiting for the first scheduled time.
versionen_tage_erklaerung: Overwritten and deleted files stay at the destination this long – one version per run.
versionen_erklaerung: One version per run with the files that were overwritten or deleted. Kept for {tage} days.
versionen_fern: The older versions are at the destination in the share's .papierkorb folder (one folder per run) – open them there directly.
versionen_keine: No older versions yet – nothing has been overwritten or deleted so far.
art_sicherung_erklaerung: Always copies the source to the target and keeps older versions. For backup copies on USB, another NAS or in the cloud.
art_spiegelung_erklaerung: Keeps two folders the same – one way or both ways. For working folders that should be current in two places.
richtung_bei_sicherung: A backup always copies from the source to the target (one way).
gruppe_sicherung_erklaerung: Copy one way and keep older versions.
gruppe_sicherung_leer: No backup yet – “Set up a backup” guides you there in four steps.
gruppe_spiegelung_leer: No mirror yet – “New mirror job” keeps two folders the same.
